title: psi is a 6.4 MB coding agent you can read
friendlyTitle: psi is a very small coding agent you can inspect
summary: psi is a portable coding agent written in ANSI C and Lua, under an MIT license. The site says the binary is 6.4 MB and runs on Linux, macOS, Windows, FreeBSD, OpenBSD, and Haiku. You bring a provider: Anthropic, OpenAI Codex, OpenRouter, or a local model through Ollama.
friendlySummary: psi is a coding agent in a 6.4 MB file. It runs on common computers and a few unusual ones. The license lets you read and change it. You still need your own model account.
whyItMatters: Most coding agents are large apps you cannot easily audit. psi keeps the loop, tools, and terminal in Lua, so a person who wants a small agent can inspect it and add a command in a few lines. It is new, and it still needs a model account to do the work.
friendlyWhyItMatters: Most coding agents are large and hard to check. This one keeps the main behavior in a simple script language, so you can read it and add a command.
